title: Getting started
description: A short tour of the demo and how its sample content is organized.

title: Overview
description: What the demo includes and where the sample content lives.
content:
This demo shows a small documentation site with an editable page tree, configurable navigation and a data-driven homepage. Every name, logo and contact detail is fictional.

What is included

  • A homepage built from optional sections.
  • A sidebar with groups and pages.
  • Header and footer menus that can be edited as data.
  • Light and dark theme options.
  • A simple contact form.

What is fictional

Partner names, logos, addresses, phone numbers and email addresses are examples only. Replace them with your own information before using the site.

Where to go next

Read Navigation and search to understand the menus, or Content model to see how groups and pages fit together.

title: Navigation and search
description: How the header menu, sidebar and search work on the public site.
content:
Header menu

The header is built from the navigation list in the appearance settings. Each entry can have a link and an optional group of child links.

Sidebar

The sidebar is generated from the page tree. Groups can be expanded and collapsed, and the current page is highlighted automatically.

Search

The search button opens a panel that looks through page titles and content. The shortcut is available from any page.

Footer links

Footer links are separate from the header menu, so you can keep the footer short while the header stays detailed.

title: Content model
description: Groups, pages and ordering explained with simple examples.
content:
Groups and pages

A group is a container for related pages. A page holds the content that visitors read. Groups can contain pages or other groups.

Ordering

Each item has an order value inside its parent. Lower values appear first. The demo uses simple numbering so the structure is easy to follow.

Visibility

Every page can be visible or hidden. Hidden pages keep their place in the tree but do not appear in the public sidebar or search results.

Paths

The path is built from the parent path and the page slug. Moving a page updates its path and the path of every child item.

title: Roles
description: The two kinds of access used by the demo.
content:
Administrator

The administrator signs in to the admin area, edits pages, changes site settings and manages backups.

Visitor

A visitor reads the public site without signing in. There are no member accounts or submissions in this demo.

Changing the password

The initial account is created when the database is first started. Change the password before sharing the demo with anyone else.

title: Account
description: Sign in and manage the demo administrator account.

title: Sign in
description: Open the admin area with the demo account.
content:
Open the admin area

  1. Go to /admin/ on the same host as the public site.
  2. Enter the username and password created at first start.
  3. Choose Sign in.

If the sign-in fails

Check the username, the password and the database connection. The server log shows whether the account was created successfully.

Security note

The default demo credentials are documented for local evaluation only. Replace them before exposing the site to a network.

title: Update your profile
description: Change the display details used by the demo.
content:
What can be changed

  • Display name.
  • Username.
  • Password.
  • Interface language.

Where to find it

Open the account menu in the admin header and choose the relevant action. Changes are saved immediately.

Public profile

This demo does not publish user profiles on the public site. Account details stay inside the admin area.

title: Reset your password
description: Recover access when the demo password is lost.
content:
With an active session

  1. Open the account menu.
  2. Choose Change password.
  3. Enter the current password and the new one.
  4. Save and sign in again.

Without a session

Reset the administrator password from the server configuration and restart the service. The exact command depends on how the demo is deployed.

Good practice

Use a unique password and store it in a password manager. Do not reuse the demo credentials on a public server.

title: Guides
description: Practical guides for editing the demo content and appearance.

title: Create and edit pages
description: Add a page, edit its content and control where it appears.
content:
Create a page

  1. Open the content tree in the admin area.
  2. Choose Add page.
  3. Enter a title and a short description.
  4. Select the parent group.
  5. Write the content in HTML.
  6. Save the page.

Edit a page

Select the page in the tree, change the fields and save. The public sidebar updates from the same data.

Hide a page

Turn off the visibility option. The page remains in the tree but disappears from the public site and search.

Remove a page

Delete the page from the tree. Child items are listed in the confirmation dialog so nothing disappears by accident.

title: Homepage sections
description: Show, hide or reorder the sections of the bundled homepage.
content:
Available sections

  • Hero
  • Benefits
  • Evolution
  • Upgrade
  • Partners
  • Features
  • Process
  • Deployment
  • Contact

Show or hide

Each section has a visibility switch. Hidden sections are skipped without affecting the rest of the page.

Change the order

Use the order number to move a section up or down. The page sorts sections before rendering.

Edit the text

Section titles, lists and buttons are plain data. Keep the field names and change only the values.

title: Colors and typography
description: Adjust the palette, fonts and theme modes of the demo.
content:
Colors

The appearance settings define primary, accent, background, text and footer colors. Use hex values so the same palette works in both themes.

Typography

Choose a body font and a heading font. A font size in pixels sets the base scale for the site.

Light and dark

Enable system, light and dark modes, or keep a single mode to hide the public switch. The admin area has its own theme control.

Preview

Save the settings and open the public site in a new tab. The demo does not cache appearance values between requests.

title: Menus and links
description: Build the header and footer navigation from simple data.
content:
Header menu

Add a label and a path for each top-level item. An item can be a direct link or a group with child links.

Nested links

Child paths are relative to the parent path. A child named overview under /getting-started becomes /getting-started/overview.

Footer links

Footer links use the same structure as the header but appear in a separate column. Keep the list short for readability.

External links

Full URLs open in a new tab. Use them for documentation, status pages or any resource outside the demo.

title: Media library
description: Upload images and keep the library tidy.
content:
Upload an image

Use the image button in the page editor, choose a file and wait for the upload to finish. The image is inserted at the cursor.

Reuse an image

Copy the image address from the editor and use it in another page or in the appearance settings.

Cleanup

When a page is saved, images that are no longer referenced in its content are removed. This keeps unused files from accumulating.

Formats

PNG, JPEG, WebP and SVG are suitable for the demo. Use a reasonable file size so pages load quickly.

title: Contact form
description: How the contact page stores and sends messages.
content:
Public form

The contact page asks for a name, email address, phone number and message. Required fields are checked before the form is sent.

Where messages go

Messages are stored in the database and can be reviewed from the admin area. The demo does not send real email.

Contact details

The phone number, email address and street address shown on the page come from the site settings. Replace the sample values before using the site.

title: Languages
description: Switch the interface language and edit translations.
content:
Included languages

The demo includes English and Vietnamese interface dictionaries. One language is the default for the admin area and one is the default for the public site.

Switch language

Use the language selector in the header. The choice is remembered for the current browser.

Edit a translation

Open the languages page in the admin area, choose a locale and update the message values. Page content itself is not translated by this feature.

title: Backup and restore
description: Export the demo data and restore it on another install.
content:
Export

The backup page creates a ZIP archive with the database records and every uploaded file. Download it to a safe location.

Restore

Choose the archive on the backup page and confirm. Existing data is replaced, so take a fresh export first.

Portability

The archive contains no server paths or domain names. It can be restored on a local machine or another demo instance.

title: Examples
description: Sample page structures you can copy or adapt.

title: Landing page
description: A simple landing page with a short message and clear actions.
content:
A landing page works best when it answers three questions quickly: what this is, who it is for and what to do next.

Suggested sections

  • A short headline and one supporting paragraph.
  • Two actions: one primary and one secondary.
  • Three proof points or benefits.
  • A closing call to action.

Keep it short

Use one idea per section and remove anything that does not help the visitor decide. The demo homepage follows the same pattern.

Reuse it

Copy the text into a new page and replace the sample values. No special layout is required.

title: Company page
description: An example structure for a company or team page.
content:
Suggested sections

  • Who we are.
  • What we do.
  • How the team works.
  • Where to find us.

Writing tips

Use concrete verbs and short paragraphs. Link to related pages instead of repeating the same text in several places.

Images

A single team photo or a simple illustration is enough. Keep file sizes small and describe the image in the alt text.

title: Support page
description: A support page that helps visitors solve common issues.
content:
Suggested sections

  • Quick answers to common questions.
  • Step-by-step checks.
  • How to contact the team.
  • Links to related guides.

Checklist

  • Put the most common issue first.
  • Use plain language.
  • Keep each answer to one short paragraph.
  • Link to the contact page at the end.

Maintenance

Review the page after each change to the demo. Remove answers that no longer apply.

title: FAQ page
description: An example question-and-answer layout.
content:
Writing good questions

  • Use the words visitors search for.
  • Ask one question per heading.
  • Answer in two or three sentences.
  • Link to a guide for the full explanation.

Example

Can I remove the sample content?

Yes. The seed is only a starting point. Delete or replace every page, partner and contact detail.

Does the demo need external services?

No. The site, admin area and data store run together in one deployment.

title: Changelog
description: A simple changelog format for the demo.
content:
Example entries

  • Version 1.2 — Added a shorter navigation example and new partner cards.
  • Version 1.1 — Improved the contact page and updated sample colors.
  • Version 1.0 — First fictional demo release.

Keep a changelog useful

Write what changed, not how much work it took. Group related changes and put the newest entry first.

Dates

Use one date format throughout. The demo uses the year and month to keep entries short.

title: About this demo
description: Why the sample content exists and what to replace before going live.
content:
This site is a fictional demonstration of a small documentation and content platform. It is not connected to any real organization, publication or service.

Fictional content

Partner names, logos, contact details, page text and example links are invented for evaluation. They do not describe real products or real people.

Before going live

  • Replace the site name, tagline and contact details.
  • Remove or rewrite every sample page.
  • Replace the example partner records.
  • Change the administrator credentials.
  • Review the privacy and cookie text.

No tracking

The demo does not include analytics scripts or third-party embeds. Add only the services you actually need.
